content.content:
1	# Feature Specification: P-RF01 — Multimodal capture
2	
3	**Feature Branch**: `003-multimodal-capture` (spec directory only — no git branch was created automatically; none of this repo's extension hooks are configured)
4	
5	**Created**: 2026-10-12
6	
7	**Status**: Draft
8	
9	**Input**: User description: "P-RF01 — Multimodal capture: Let the user create a journal entry by text, audio recording or photo, from the Insertion Modal, per docs/input/requirements.md section 1 (RF01) and its acceptance criteria. Prototype states: Insertion modal — 'Texto', 'Áudio — Gravando', 'Foto — Captura' (prototype extract, section 2.3), opened by the '+' button of Home/Chat. Backend: POST /entries with source manual/audio/photo. Depends on F000, RF03. Do not implement features of later units, extension features (requirements section 2), or change the backend."
10	
11	## Clarifications
12	
13	### Session 2026-10-12
14	
15	- Q: When a user stops recording audio or captures a photo in this unit, how should Save behave, given RF02 (speech-to-text/OCR) is an explicitly later unit and the prototype states listed for this unit stop at "Gravando" and "Captura"? → A: RF01 performs the minimal on-device transcription (audio) or backend OCR call (photo) needed to produce text content inline, as part of confirming Save, shown with only a plain/generic loading indicator — not RF02's dedicated "Processando / Transcrito / Reconhecido / Erro" screens, their editable-text review step, or their specific retry affordances ("Tentar novamente", "Salvar só a foto"). This is the only reading under which RF01 alone satisfies its own stated acceptance criterion that all three modalities "result in the same persisted-entry format," since entries are immutable (no `PATCH`/`DELETE /entries/:id`) and therefore cannot be corrected after creation — recognition must happen before the entry exists. (Resolved by technical judgment per user direction, applying Constitution Principle I, where the input docs are silent on this exact boundary.)
16	- Q: After a successful Save, the modal closes back to Home/Chat — but Home/Chat never renders journal entries (those appear only in the later "Meus Registros" unit, RF07). What should FR-011's "reflected in the app's state" actually look like on Home/Chat itself? → A: Nothing new is shown on Home/Chat. The prototype documents no confirmation screen, toast, or any other on-screen change for this flow, and inventing one would conflict with Principle IV's visual-fidelity constraint (faithfulness to a frozen prototype that defines no such state) as well as SC-003's "no required intermediate screens." "Reflected in the app's state" means only that the newly created entry is added to the app's local entries store/cache — the same store later units (e.g., RF07) will read from — not that Home/Chat's UI changes in any visible way. (Resolved by technical judgment per user direction, applying Constitution Principles I and IV, where the input docs are silent on this exact boundary.)
17	- Q: The backend's `POST /media/ocr` response carries a `confidence: "high"|"low"` field alongside the recognized text — does a `low`-confidence recognition get treated any differently from `high`-confidence before Save completes? → A: No. This unit's scope (FR-007) stops at automatically producing recognized text before Save; any quality gating, warning, or review step keyed to confidence is exactly the kind of recognition-quality handling RF02 owns (its "Transcrito"/"Reconhecido" review states, deliberately deferred here). Confidence is therefore ignored in this unit: any non-empty recognized text, regardless of confidence, proceeds to Save normally; only the already-specified zero-usable-text case (Edge Cases) is treated as a failure. (Resolved by technical judgment per user direction, applying Constitution Principle I, where the input docs are silent on this exact boundary.)
18	
19	## User Scenarios & Testing *(mandatory)*
20	
21	### User Story 1 - Writing a journal entry as text (Priority: P1)
22	
23	A user wants to quickly note something in words. They tap "+" on Home/Chat, the Insertion Modal opens on its "Texto" tab, they write freely in the text field, and tap "Salvar". The modal closes and the note now exists as one of their journal entries.
24	
25	**Why this priority**: The simplest and fully self-contained of the three capture paths — it has no dependency on recognition of any kind, so it is the first thing that must work end to end.
26	
27	**Independent Test**: Can be fully tested by tapping "+", typing text into the Texto tab, tapping "Salvar", and confirming a new entry with that exact text and origin "manual" now exists, and the modal has closed back to Home/Chat.
28	
29	**Acceptance Scenarios**:
30	
31	1. **Given** Home/Chat is open, **When** the user taps "+", **Then** the Insertion Modal opens as an overlay on top of Home/Chat (which stays in place underneath), defaulted to the "Texto" tab with an empty field.
32	2. **Given** the Texto tab with text typed into the field, **When** the user taps "Salvar", **Then** a new journal entry is created with that text as its content and origin "manual", and the modal closes, returning to Home/Chat.
33	3. **Given** the Texto tab with an empty field, **When** the user looks at "Salvar", **Then** the action is unavailable (disabled), so an empty entry can never be created.
34	
35	---
36	
37	### User Story 2 - Recording a journal entry as audio (Priority: P1)
38	
39	A user prefers to speak rather than type. They tap "+", switch to the "Áudio" tab, and recording begins with a visible waveform and timer. They tap stop, and after a brief moment the spoken content is saved as a journal entry just like a written one.
40	
41	**Why this priority**: Voice capture is one of the two microphone/camera-dependent paths and, together with Story 1, establishes that every modality converges on the same entry format — the central acceptance criterion of this unit.
42	
43	**Independent Test**: Can be fully tested by opening the Áudio tab, recording a short spoken note, stopping the recording, confirming Save completes, and confirming a new entry exists with origin "audio" and text content derived from what was spoken.
44	
45	**Acceptance Scenarios**:
46	
47	1. **Given** the Insertion Modal is open, **When** the user switches to the "Áudio" tab, **Then** recording starts immediately, showing a stop control, an animated waveform, and a running mm:ss timer.
48	2. **Given** an active recording, **When** the user taps stop, **Then** the recording ends and the system automatically transcribes it and completes the save as part of confirming the capture, producing one new entry with origin "audio" and the transcribed text as its content.
49	3. **Given** a completed audio capture that is being transcribed and saved, **When** that processing is underway, **Then** the user sees a plain loading indicator (not a detailed multi-state screen) until it finishes.
50	4. **Given** transcription or the save itself fails (e.g., inaudible recording, network timeout), **When** that happens, **Then** no entry is created, a clear failure message is shown, and the user can retry without having to re-record, as long as the captured audio is still held locally.
51	
52	---
53	
54	### User Story 3 - Capturing a journal entry from a photo (Priority: P2)
55	
56	A user has something written down on paper, a receipt, or a whiteboard. They tap "+", switch to the "Foto" tab, choose "Câmera" or "Galeria", and the text in the image becomes a journal entry.
57	
58	**Why this priority**: Mirrors Story 2's recognition pipeline for a second input type; ordered after audio because the text-recognition concern it shares with Story 2 is already established there.
59	
60	**Independent Test**: Can be fully tested by opening the Foto tab, choosing "Câmera" or "Galeria" to supply an image containing legible text, confirming the save completes, and confirming a new entry exists with origin "photo" and the recognized text as its content.
61	
62	**Acceptance Scenarios**:
63	
64	1. **Given** the Insertion Modal is open, **When** the user switches to the "Foto" tab, **Then** two options are shown — "Câmera" and "Galeria" — with no image selected yet.
65	2. **Given** the user picks "Câmera" or "Galeria" and supplies an image, **When** that image is provided, **Then** the system automatically extracts its text and completes the save as part of confirming the capture, producing one new entry with origin "photo" and the recognized text as its content.
66	3. **Given** a completed photo capture that is being recognized and saved, **When** that processing is underway, **Then** the user sees a plain loading indicator (not a detailed multi-state screen) until it finishes.
67	4. **Given** text recognition or the save itself fails, **When** that happens, **Then** no entry is created, a clear failure message is shown, and the user can retry without having to recapture the image, as long as it is still held locally.
68	
69	---
70	
71	### User Story 4 - Abandoning a capture leaves nothing behind (Priority: P3)
72	
73	A user starts writing, recording, or photographing, changes their mind, and backs out. Nothing about that attempt is saved anywhere.
74	
75	**Why this priority**: A safety property that applies across all three modalities rather than a feature of its own; depends on Stories 1–3 already existing to have something to abandon.
76	
77	**Independent Test**: Can be fully tested by starting each modality (typing a partial note, starting a recording, opening the camera/gallery picker) and closing the modal or navigating away before tapping Salvar, then confirming no new entry was created in any case.
78	
79	**Acceptance Scenarios**:
80	
81	1. **Given** partially typed text in the Texto tab, **When** the user closes the modal without tapping "Salvar", **Then** no entry is created and the draft text is discarded.
82	2. **Given** an in-progress audio recording, **When** the user closes the modal or stops without confirming save, **Then** no entry is created and no partially-recorded audio is persisted as an entry.
83	3. **Given** the Foto tab's camera/gallery picker is open, **When** the user cancels it without completing a capture, **Then** no entry is created.
84	
85	---
86	
87	### Edge Cases
88

# Feature Specification: P-RF01 — Multimodal capture

**Feature Branch**: `003-multimodal-capture` (spec directory only — no git branch was created automatically; none of this repo's extension hooks are configured)

**Created**: 2026-10-12

**Status**: Draft

**Input**: User description: "P-RF01 — Multimodal capture: Let the user create a journal entry by text, audio recording or photo, from the Insertion Modal, per docs/input/requirements.md section 1 (RF01) and its acceptance criteria. Prototype states: Insertion modal — 'Texto', 'Áudio — Gravando', 'Foto — Captura' (prototype extract, section 2.3), opened by the '+' button of Home/Chat. Backend: POST /entries with source manual/audio/photo. Depends on F000, RF03. Do not implement features of later units, extension features (requirements section 2), or change the backend."

## Clarifications

### Session 2026-10-12

- Q: When a user stops recording audio or captures a photo in this unit, how should Save behave, given RF02 (speech-to-text/OCR) is an explicitly later unit and the prototype states listed for this unit stop at "Gravando" and "Captura"? → A: RF01 performs the minimal on-device transcription (audio) or backend OCR call (photo) needed to produce text content inline, as part of confirming Save, shown with only a plain/generic loading indicator — not RF02's dedicated "Processando / Transcrito / Reconhecido / Erro" screens, their editable-text review step, or their specific retry affordances ("Tentar novamente", "Salvar só a foto"). This is the only reading under which RF01 alone satisfies its own stated acceptance criterion that all three modalities "result in the same persisted-entry format," since entries are immutable (no `PATCH`/`DELETE /entries/:id`) and therefore cannot be corrected after creation — recognition must happen before the entry exists. (Resolved by technical judgment per user direction, applying Constitution Principle I, where the input docs are silent on this exact boundary.)
- Q: After a successful Save, the modal closes back to Home/Chat — but Home/Chat never renders journal entries (those appear only in the later "Meus Registros" unit, RF07). What should FR-011's "reflected in the app's state" actually look like on Home/Chat itself? → A: Nothing new is shown on Home/Chat. The prototype documents no confirmation screen, toast, or any other on-screen change for this flow, and inventing one would conflict with Principle IV's visual-fidelity constraint (faithfulness to a frozen prototype that defines no such state) as well as SC-003's "no required intermediate screens." "Reflected in the app's state" means only that the newly created entry is added to the app's local entries store/cache — the same store later units (e.g., RF07) will read from — not that Home/Chat's UI changes in any visible way. (Resolved by technical judgment per user direction, applying Constitution Principles I and IV, where the input docs are silent on this exact boundary.)
- Q: The backend's `POST /media/ocr` response carries a `confidence: "high"|"low"` field alongside the recognized text — does a `low`-confidence recognition get treated any differently from `high`-confidence before Save completes? → A: No. This unit's scope (FR-007) stops at automatically producing recognized text before Save; any quality gating, warning, or review step keyed to confidence is exactly the kind of recognition-quality handling RF02 owns (its "Transcrito"/"Reconhecido" review states, deliberately deferred here). Confidence is therefore ignored in this unit: any non-empty recognized text, regardless of confidence, proceeds to Save normally; only the already-specified zero-usable-text case (Edge Cases) is treated as a failure. (Resolved by technical judgment per user direction, applying Constitution Principle I, where the input docs are silent on this exact boundary.)

## User Scenarios & Testing *(mandatory)*

### User Story 1 - Writing a journal entry as text (Priority: P1)

A user wants to quickly note something in words. They tap "+" on Home/Chat, the Insertion Modal opens on its "Texto" tab, they write freely in the text field, and tap "Salvar". The modal closes and the note now exists as one of their journal entries.

**Why this priority**: The simplest and fully self-contained of the three capture paths — it has no dependency on recognition of any kind, so it is the first thing that must work end to end.

**Independent Test**: Can be fully tested by tapping "+", typing text into the Texto tab, tapping "Salvar", and confirming a new entry with that exact text and origin "manual" now exists, and the modal has closed back to Home/Chat.

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** Home/Chat is open, **When** the user taps "+", **Then** the Insertion Modal opens as an overlay on top of Home/Chat (which stays in place underneath), defaulted to the "Texto" tab with an empty field.
2. **Given** the Texto tab with text typed into the field, **When** the user taps "Salvar", **Then** a new journal entry is created with that text as its content and origin "manual", and the modal closes, returning to Home/Chat.
3. **Given** the Texto tab with an empty field, **When** the user looks at "Salvar", **Then** the action is unavailable (disabled), so an empty entry can never be created.

---

### User Story 2 - Recording a journal entry as audio (Priority: P1)

A user prefers to speak rather than type. They tap "+", switch to the "Áudio" tab, and recording begins with a visible waveform and timer. They tap stop, and after a brief moment the spoken content is saved as a journal entry just like a written one.

**Why this priority**: Voice capture is one of the two microphone/camera-dependent paths and, together with Story 1, establishes that every modality converges on the same entry format — the central acceptance criterion of this unit.

**Independent Test**: Can be fully tested by opening the Áudio tab, recording a short spoken note, stopping the recording, confirming Save completes, and confirming a new entry exists with origin "audio" and text content derived from what was spoken.

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** the Insertion Modal is open, **When** the user switches to the "Áudio" tab, **Then** recording starts immediately, showing a stop control, an animated waveform, and a running mm:ss timer.
2. **Given** an active recording, **When** the user taps stop, **Then** the recording ends and the system automatically transcribes it and completes the save as part of confirming the capture, producing one new entry with origin "audio" and the transcribed text as its content.
3. **Given** a completed audio capture that is being transcribed and saved, **When** that processing is underway, **Then** the user sees a plain loading indicator (not a detailed multi-state screen) until it finishes.
4. **Given** transcription or the save itself fails (e.g., inaudible recording, network timeout), **When** that happens, **Then** no entry is created, a clear failure message is shown, and the user can retry without having to re-record, as long as the captured audio is still held locally.

---

### User Story 3 - Capturing a journal entry from a photo (Priority: P2)

A user has something written down on paper, a receipt, or a whiteboard. They tap "+", switch to the "Foto" tab, choose "Câmera" or "Galeria", and the text in the image becomes a journal entry.

**Why this priority**: Mirrors Story 2's recognition pipeline for a second input type; ordered after audio because the text-recognition concern it shares with Story 2 is already established there.

**Independent Test**: Can be fully tested by opening the Foto tab, choosing "Câmera" or "Galeria" to supply an image containing legible text, confirming the save completes, and confirming a new entry exists with origin "photo" and the recognized text as its content.

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** the Insertion Modal is open, **When** the user switches to the "Foto" tab, **Then** two options are shown — "Câmera" and "Galeria" — with no image selected yet.
2. **Given** the user picks "Câmera" or "Galeria" and supplies an image, **When** that image is provided, **Then** the system automatically extracts its text and completes the save as part of confirming the capture, producing one new entry with origin "photo" and the recognized text as its content.
3. **Given** a completed photo capture that is being recognized and saved, **When** that processing is underway, **Then** the user sees a plain loading indicator (not a detailed multi-state screen) until it finishes.
4. **Given** text recognition or the save itself fails, **When** that happens, **Then** no entry is created, a clear failure message is shown, and the user can retry without having to recapture the image, as long as it is still held locally.

---

### User Story 4 - Abandoning a capture leaves nothing behind (Priority: P3)

A user starts writing, recording, or photographing, changes their mind, and backs out. Nothing about that attempt is saved anywhere.

**Why this priority**: A safety property that applies across all three modalities rather than a feature of its own; depends on Stories 1–3 already existing to have something to abandon.

**Independent Test**: Can be fully tested by starting each modality (typing a partial note, starting a recording, opening the camera/gallery picker) and closing the modal or navigating away before tapping Salvar, then confirming no new entry was created in any case.

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** partially typed text in the Texto tab, **When** the user closes the modal without tapping "Salvar", **Then** no entry is created and the draft text is discarded.
2. **Given** an in-progress audio recording, **When** the user closes the modal or stops without confirming save, **Then** no entry is created and no partially-recorded audio is persisted as an entry.
3. **Given** the Foto tab's camera/gallery picker is open, **When** the user cancels it without completing a capture, **Then** no entry is created.

---

### Edge Cases

- Microphone or camera permission is denied at the OS level: the respective tab shows an explanatory message in place of the recording/capture controls, instead of silently failing or crashing.
- The user switches tabs while a recording is in progress: the in-progress recording is discarded (same outcome as closing the modal), since no partial entry may survive regardless of which tab is active afterward.
- The app is backgrounded or killed while a capture is in progress and unsaved: nothing is lost that mattered, because nothing was persisted yet — on return, the modal reopens to its default empty state.

- The device is offline when the user taps "Salvar": the save is blocked immediately with a clear message, without attempting a network call that cannot succeed, consistent with this product's cloud-only architecture (no offline writes).
- The user double-taps "Salvar": only one entry is ever created per confirmed capture, never duplicates.

## Requirements *(mandatory)*

### Functional Requirements

- **FR-008**: If a capture is abandoned before Save is confirmed — the modal is closed, the user navigates away, a recording is stopped without saving, or an in-progress camera/gallery selection is cancelled — the system MUST NOT create any entry, partial or empty, for that capture.

2

4

9	reference), §13 (technical constraints), and `.specify/memory/constitution.md`. Depends on F000
10	(`specs/001-foundation/`) and RF03 (`specs/002-biometric-auth-vault/`), both already implemented.
11	
12	## Summary
13	
14	RF01 gives Home/Chat's composer a real "+" button (F000 shipped none — research.md R9) that opens
15	a bottom-sheet Insertion Modal with three tabs: Texto (free text), Áudio (auto-starts recording on
16	tab activation), Foto (camera/gallery choice). Confirming Save — tapping "Salvar" for Texto,
17	tapping stop for Áudio, or supplying an image for Foto (research.md R6) — runs the minimal
18	recognition this unit owns (on-device Whisper transcription for audio, the backend's existing
19	`media-ocr` call for photo, per the spec's resolved Clarification) and then creates exactly one
20	journal entry through a brand-new `entries` feature's shared `CreateEntryUseCase` — the same seam
21	`requirements.md`'s RF10 text already names and will extend later, never bypass (research.md R8).
22	Recognition and the entry-creation call both show only a plain, generic loading indicator;
23	dedicated multi-state recognition screens, an editable review step, and modality-specific retry
24	affordances are explicitly RF02's to build, not this unit's (FR-007). An offline Save is blocked
25	before any network call is attempted, via a new cross-cutting `ConnectivityChecker` (research.md
26	R5) that later offline-gated units (RF04, RF06) can reuse. No backend/contract change.
27	
28	## Technical Context
29	
30	**Language/Version**: Dart 3.13.4 / Flutter 3.47.5 (stable), pinned via `.fvmrc` — unchanged from
31	F000/RF03, no new pin needed.
32	
33	**Primary Dependencies** (additions on top of F000/RF03's stack):
34	- `record` — real-time microphone capture with a live amplitude signal (research.md R1).
35	- `whisper_ggml` — on-device speech-to-text; **fixed by Constitution Principle II**, not a choice
36	  (research.md R2).
37	- `image_picker` — camera/gallery photo selection (research.md R3).
38	- `connectivity_plus` — interface-level online/offline check powering the new `ConnectivityChecker`
39	  (research.md R5).
40	- `path_provider` — resolves a writable directory for the one-time Whisper model-asset copy
41	  (research.md R2).
42	- Reused unchanged from F000/RF03: `flutter_bloc`, `fpdart`, `dio` (via `ApiClient`), `get_it`,
43	  `equatable`; dev-only `mocktail`, `bloc_test`. `flutter_secure_storage`/`local_auth`/`crypto` are
44	  not touched by this unit.
45	
46	**Storage**: No new local database and no new secure-storage key. The only new "storage" this unit
47	introduces is in-memory: `EntriesRepositoryImpl`'s `cachedEntries` list (process lifetime, via
48	`get_it`'s `lazySingleton` — same pattern as RF03's `VaultRepository`) and the two bloc-private
49	temp-file paths (`_pendingAudioPath`/`_pendingImagePath`) that exist only while the modal is open,

# Implementation Plan: P-RF01 — Multimodal capture

**Branch**: `003-multimodal-capture` (spec directory only — no git branch exists; see spec header)

**Date**: 2026-10-12 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/003-multimodal-capture/spec.md`,
`docs/input/requirements.md` §1 (RF01), §6.2 (`/entries`, `/media/ocr`), §9 (data model
reference), §13 (technical constraints), and `.specify/memory/constitution.md`. Depends on F000
(`specs/001-foundation/`) and RF03 (`specs/002-biometric-auth-vault/`), both already implemented.

## Summary

RF01 gives Home/Chat's composer a real "+" button (F000 shipped none — research.md R9) that opens
a bottom-sheet Insertion Modal with three tabs: Texto (free text), Áudio (auto-starts recording on
tab activation), Foto (camera/gallery choice). Confirming Save — tapping "Salvar" for Texto,
tapping stop for Áudio, or supplying an image for Foto (research.md R6) — runs the minimal
recognition this unit owns (on-device Whisper transcription for audio, the backend's existing
`media-ocr` call for photo, per the spec's resolved Clarification) and then creates exactly one
journal entry through a brand-new `entries` feature's shared `CreateEntryUseCase` — the same seam
`requirements.md`'s RF10 text already names and will extend later, never bypass (research.md R8).
Recognition and the entry-creation call both show only a plain, generic loading indicator;
dedicated multi-state recognition screens, an editable review step, and modality-specific retry
affordances are explicitly RF02's to build, not this unit's (FR-007). An offline Save is blocked
before any network call is attempted, via a new cross-cutting `ConnectivityChecker` (research.md
R5) that later offline-gated units (RF04, RF06) can reuse. No backend/contract change.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Dart 3.13.4 / Flutter 3.47.5 (stable), pinned via `.fvmrc` — unchanged from
F000/RF03, no new pin needed.

**Primary Dependencies** (additions on top of F000/RF03's stack):
- `record` — real-time microphone capture with a live amplitude signal (research.md R1).
- `whisper_ggml` — on-device speech-to-text; **fixed by Constitution Principle II**, not a choice
  (research.md R2).
- `image_picker` — camera/gallery photo selection (research.md R3).
- `connectivity_plus` — interface-level online/offline check powering the new `ConnectivityChecker`
  (research.md R5).
- `path_provider` — resolves a writable directory for the one-time Whisper model-asset copy
  (research.md R2).
- Reused unchanged from F000/RF03: `flutter_bloc`, `fpdart`, `dio` (via `ApiClient`), `get_it`,
  `equatable`; dev-only `mocktail`, `bloc_test`. `flutter_secure_storage`/`local_auth`/`crypto` are
  not touched by this unit.

**Storage**: No new local database and no new secure-storage key. The only new "storage" this unit
introduces is in-memory: `EntriesRepositoryImpl`'s `cachedEntries` list (process lifetime, via
`get_it`'s `lazySingleton` — same pattern as RF03's `VaultRepository`) and the two bloc-private
temp-file paths (`_pendingAudioPath`/`_pendingImagePath`) that exist only while the modal is open,
to support FR-009's retry-without-recapture. The temp WAV/JPEG files themselves live wherever
`record`/`image_picker` write them (OS-managed app sandbox temp/cache dirs) — this unit does not
manage their cleanup beyond what `AudioCaptureRepository.discard()` deletes explicitly.

**Testing**: `flutter_test` + `bloc_test` + `mocktail`, identical to F000/RF03; coverage via
`fvm flutter test --coverage`, same `lib/**/domain/**` lcov filter for the RNF07 gate, now also
covering `lib/features/entries/domain/` and `lib/features/capture/domain/`. `record`,
`image_picker`, and `whisper_ggml` all have no platform channel under `flutter_test` — see
quickstart.md for the manual iOS Simulator verification Stories 1–4 and their Edge Cases need.

**Target Platform**: iOS, portrait only — unchanged. `IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET` raised from
`15.0` to `15.6` (research.md R2, `whisper_ggml`'s documented floor) across all three build
configurations in `ios/Runner.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj`. Three new `Info.plist` usage-description
strings (`NSMicrophoneUsageDescription`, `NSCameraUsageDescription`,
`NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription` — research.md R1/R3); no other native project change.

**Project Type**: Same single Flutter mobile app. This unit adds two new feature folders —
`lib/features/entries/` (the shared entry-creation seam, research.md R8) and
`lib/features/capture/` (the Insertion Modal UI and its audio/photo pipelines) — and touches one
existing F000 file (`home_chat_shell_page.dart`, to add the real "+" button — research.md R9). No
backend/server code, no change to `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`.

**Performance Goals**: RNF01 — every network call this unit makes (`entries-create`, `media-ocr`)
shows the existing plain loading indicator (`DesignTokens.sizeLoadingIndicator`/
`strokeWidthLoadingIndicator`, already present from F000/RF03) whenever it exceeds 300 ms; the one
local action with its own 100 ms bar is the Texto tab's "Salvar" enabled/disabled toggle as the
field's emptiness changes, and the Áudio tab's recording starting "immediately" on tab activation.

  own styling), no editable review step, no modality-specific retry affordances ("Tentar
  novamente" styled to match RF02's named Erro states, "Salvar só a foto") — FR-007, research.md

  contracts/*.md.
- Zero visual values hardcoded outside `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` (Principle IV/RNF08) — this
  unit needs no new token (research.md R10), reusing F000/RF03's existing scale entirely.

**Scale/Scope**: 1 new "+" button on an existing screen (research.md R9); 1 new bottom-sheet page
(`InsertionModalPage`) with 3 tab widgets, backed by 1 screen-scoped bloc covering 11 sub-states
across the three tabs (contracts/insertion-modal-bloc.md); 2 new feature folders
(`entries`, `capture`) with 2 new network-backed repositories (`EntriesRepository`,

228	- **User Stories (Phase 3–6)**: All depend on Foundational completion.

230	    the one that first registers `InsertionModalBloc` in DI (T024) and adds the real "+" button
231	    (T027), which US2/US3 build on.
232	  - US2 (P1) and US3 (P2) each extend the same `InsertionModalBloc`/`insertion_modal_event.dart`/

234	    extend the bloc's constructor; T045/T062 both extend the page's `BlocBuilder` switch) — doing
235	    them in priority order (US2 before US3) avoids rework, even though each is independently

237	  - US4 (P3) depends on US2's and US3's `*Recording`/`*Saving`/`*Captura` states already existing
238	    to have something to abandon (T065 extends the same `ModalClosed` handler T017 stubbed).

242	
243	- Domain entities/enums before repository interfaces; repository interfaces before data sources
244	  and usecases; usecases before bloc wiring; bloc wiring before the tab-view widget that reads it;
245	  DI registration before the "+"/tab-selection path that resolves the bloc from `get_it`.
246	- Tests are written alongside (and can be run immediately after) each implementation task, per the
247	  file pairing above, rather than strictly before — this project's F000/RF03 precedent write/extend
248	  the same test file across a story's tasks rather than one file per task.
249	- Story complete (domain + data + bloc + widget + tests) before moving to the next priority.

251	### Parallel Opportunities
252	
253	- T002, T004 (Setup) in parallel with T001/T003 once each is independently actionable.
254	- T005, T013 (entities/connectivity) in parallel within Foundational; T015/T016/T018 (event/state/
255	  tab-bar skeletons) in parallel with each other and with the `entries` feature tasks.
256	- T008, T010, T012 (test files) can be written in parallel with each other once their respective
257	  implementation task lands.
258	- T020/T021 (US1 bloc event/state additions) in parallel with T022/T023 (US1 usecase + its test) —

260	- T029/T030/T031 (US2 domain types) in parallel with each other; T048/T049 (US3 domain types) in
261	  parallel with each other.
262	- T036/T038 and T054/T056 (test files) in parallel with their respective sibling implementation
263	  task's dependents once that task lands.

268	
269	```bash

271	Task: "Create Entry entity + enums in lib/features/entries/domain/entities/entry.dart"
272	Task: "Create ConnectivityChecker in lib/core/network/connectivity_checker.dart"
273	Task: "Create CaptureTab enum + InsertionModalEvent base in lib/features/capture/presentation/bloc/insertion_modal_event.dart"
274	Task: "Create InsertionModalState base in lib/features/capture/presentation/bloc/insertion_modal_state.dart"
275	```

281	Task: "Create AudioCaptureRepository interface in lib/features/capture/domain/repositories/audio_capture_repository.dart"
282	Task: "Create AudioTranscriptionRepository interface in lib/features/capture/domain/repositories/audio_transcription_repository.dart"
283	```

287	## Implementation Strategy
288	
289	### MVP First (User Story 1 Only)
290	
291	1. Complete Phase 1: Setup.
292	2. Complete Phase 2: Foundational (CRITICAL — blocks all stories).
293	3. Complete Phase 3: User Story 1.
294	4. **STOP and VALIDATE**: tap "+", type text, tap "Salvar" — a new "manual" entry exists and the
295	   modal closes back to Home/Chat with no other visible change.
296	
297	### Incremental Delivery
298	
299	1. Setup + Foundational → the `entries` feature and modal shell exist (Texto-only skeleton).
300	2. Add US1 → text capture works end to end; the "+" button exists for the first time.
301	3. Add US2 → audio capture converges on the same entry format as text (the central acceptance
302	   criterion, SC-001).
303	4. Add US3 → photo capture converges on the same entry format too; all three modalities proven
304	   structurally identical.
305	5. Add US4 → the safety property that no modality ever leaves a partial/empty entry behind.
306	6. Polish → RNF06/07 gates + quickstart's full manual pass.
307	
308	---
309	
310	## Notes
311	
312	- `insertion_modal_bloc.dart`, `insertion_modal_event.dart`, `insertion_modal_state.dart`, and
313	  `insertion_modal_page.dart` are each touched by multiple story phases (T017/T025/T041/T059/T065
314	  for the bloc; T015/T020/T040/T058 for events; T016/T021/T039/T057 for states; T019/T027/T045/T062
315	  for the page) — this is the deliberate single-screen/single-bloc shape contracts/

317	- `AudioTranscriptionRepository.transcribe()` deliberately returns `Either<RecognitionFailure, T>`,
318	  **not** `Either<Failure, T>` — it has no network call and no corresponding backend code
319	  (research.md R7). `PhotoRecognitionRepository.recognize()`, by contrast, is a real network call

325	  anywhere, including in the UI (T061) — confidence-based quality gating is explicitly RF02's
326	  concern (Clarification 3).

# Tasks: P-RF01 — Multimodal capture

**Input**: Design documents from `/specs/003-multimodal-capture/`

**Prerequisites**: plan.md, spec.md, research.md, data-model.md, contracts/, quickstart.md (all present)

**Tests**: Included. The constitution's RNF07 (`lib/**/domain/**` ≥80% coverage) and RNF09
(15/15 write-endpoint failure scenarios via `mocktail`) gates apply to this unit, and
quickstart.md's "Automated checks" section explicitly names the domain/data tests this unit's
coverage depends on — so test tasks are generated alongside implementation, matching
F000/RF03's existing `bloc_test`/`mocktail` style exactly.

**Organization**: Tasks are grouped by user story (US1–US4, spec.md priorities P1/P1/P2/P3). Per
contracts/insertion-modal-bloc.md, all four stories share one page/bloc
(`InsertionModalPage`/`InsertionModalBloc`) by deliberate design (research.md R6) — "independent"
here means each story's acceptance scenarios can be exercised and automated-tested on their own
once Foundational is done, not that each story gets its own screen or bloc. `entries/` (research.md
R8) is built once in Foundational because all three capture modalities (US1–US3) depend on
`CreateEntryUseCase` to persist their result.

## Format: `[ID] [P?] [Story] Description`

- **[P]**: Can run in parallel (different files, no dependencies on an incomplete task)
- **[Story]**: US1 (text entry), US2 (audio entry), US3 (photo entry), US4 (abandoning a capture
  leaves nothing behind)

## Path Conventions

Single Flutter project (F000/RF03's existing `lib/`, `test/`) — see plan.md Project Structure. All
new files live under `lib/features/entries/`, `lib/features/capture/`, `test/features/entries/`,
`test/features/capture/`, and one new `lib/core/network/connectivity_checker.dart`; one existing
F000 file (`home_chat_shell_page.dart`) and the shared `service_locator.dart`/`pubspec.yaml`/iOS
project files are touched at documented extension points.

- [ ] T063 [US3] Register `ImagePickerDataSource`, `PhotoCaptureRepository`, `MediaOcrRemoteDataSource`, `PhotoRecognitionRepository`, and `SavePhotoEntryUseCase` in `lib/core/di/service_locator.dart`, and update `InsertionModalBloc`'s factory registration to inject `PhotoCaptureRepository` and `SavePhotoEntryUseCase` alongside the audio/text dependencies — depends on T051, T053, T055, T046
- [ ] T064 [P] [US3] Extend `InsertionModalBloc` tests in `insertion_modal_bloc_test.dart` for the Foto flow: `TabSelected(foto)` → `InsertionModalFotoCaptura`; `PhotoSourceSelected` cancelled (`null`) stays on `InsertionModalFotoCaptura`; success triggers the close side-effect and appends to `cachedEntries`; recognition failure / `OCR_NO_TEXT` / entry-creation failure each map to `InsertionModalFotoFailure` with the correct message; `RetryRequested` re-uses `_pendingImagePath` without calling `pickImage()` again — depends on T059, T060

**Checkpoint**: User Stories 1, 2, AND 3 all work independently — all three modalities converge on
the same persisted-entry format (SC-001).

---

## Phase 6: User Story 4 - Abandoning a capture leaves nothing behind (Priority: P3)

**Goal**: Closing the modal, navigating away, stopping a recording without saving, or cancelling
the photo picker — in any tab, at any point before Save is confirmed — leaves zero entries behind.

**Independent Test**: Start each modality (typing a partial note, starting a recording, opening the
camera/gallery picker) and close the modal or navigate away before tapping Salvar; confirm no new
entry was created in any case.

### Implementation for User Story 4

- [ ] T065 [US4] Extend `InsertionModalBloc`'s `ModalClosed` handler (placeholder from T017) to call `AudioCaptureRepository.discard()` if `state is InsertionModalAudioRecording` and clear `_pendingAudioPath`/`_pendingImagePath` — "the system MUST NOT create any entry, partial or empty, for that capture" (FR-008); the bloc itself is then disposed by `BlocProvider` as the sheet closes, with nothing further to do — depends on T041, T059
- [ ] T066 [P] [US4] Extend `InsertionModalBloc` tests in `insertion_modal_bloc_test.dart` with abandonment scenarios across all three modalities: partially typed `InsertionModalTexto` + `ModalClosed` → no `CreateEntryUseCase` call, draft discarded; `ModalClosed` during `InsertionModalAudioRecording` → `discard()` called, no entry; `PhotoSourceSelected` cancelled or `ModalClosed` during `InsertionModalFotoCaptura` → no entry; re-confirm `TabSelected(<other>)` mid-recording (covered by T047) also produces zero entries — SC-002's "100% of abandoned captures... leave zero entries behind" — depends on T065
- [ ] T067 [US4] Confirm `InsertionModalPage`'s `showModalBottomSheet` call (wired in T027) constructs a brand-new `BlocProvider<InsertionModalBloc>` on every open, so no tab selection, draft text, or sub-state survives a close-then-reopen cycle ("MUST reset every tab to its initial, empty state each time the modal is freshly opened" — FR-002) — depends on T027, T065

**Checkpoint**: All four user stories are independently functional.

---

## Phase 7: Polish & Cross-Cutting Concerns

**Purpose**: The constitution/quickstart gates that span every story above.

- [ ] T068 [P] Run `fvm flutter analyze` and resolve any `always_use_package_imports`/lint findings under `lib/features/entries/` and `lib/features/capture/`
- [ ] T069 [P] Run `test/architecture/domain_purity_test.dart` and confirm it still reports 0 violations with `lib/features/entries/domain/` and `lib/features/capture/domain/` included — no `package:flutter`, `record`, `image_picker`, or `whisper_ggml` type may appear in either `domain/` (RNF06)
- [ ] T070 Run `fvm flutter test --coverage`, extract `lib/**/domain/**` via `lcov --extract coverage/lcov.info 'lib/**/domain/**' -o coverage/domain.info`, and confirm ≥80% coverage with `lib/features/entries/domain/` and `lib/features/capture/domain/` included (RNF07)
- [ ] T071 Execute quickstart.md's manual verification on the iOS Simulator for Stories 1–4 and its Edge Cases: microphone/camera permission denial shows an explanatory message with no crash; tab-switch mid-recording discards the recording; the app backgrounded/killed mid-capture loses nothing because nothing was persisted, and the modal reopens empty; transcription/OCR succeeding with no usable text (silence / blank or illegible image) fails Save with a clear message rather than creating a near-empty entry, while a `low`-confidence-but-non-empty OCR result still proceeds normally (Clarification 3); airplane mode blocks Save immediately before any `entries-create`/`media-ocr` call is attempted (FR-010/SC-005); double-tapping "Salvar" on a slow connection creates exactly one entry

---

## Dependencies & Execution Order

### Phase Dependencies

- **Setup (Phase 1)**: No dependencies — start immediately.
- **Foundational (Phase 2)**: Depends on Setup (T004's bundled model asset is read by US2's T034) — BLOCKS all user stories.
- **User Stories (Phase 3–6)**: All depend on Foundational completion.
  - US1 (P1) should be done first — it is the only story with no recognition dependency, and it is
    the one that first registers `InsertionModalBloc` in DI (T024) and adds the real "+" button
    (T027), which US2/US3 build on.
  - US2 (P1) and US3 (P2) each extend the same `InsertionModalBloc`/`insertion_modal_event.dart`/
    `insertion_modal_state.dart`/`insertion_modal_page.dart` files US1 touches (T041/T059 both
    extend the bloc's constructor; T045/T062 both extend the page's `BlocBuilder` switch) — doing
    them in priority order (US2 before US3) avoids rework, even though each is independently
    testable once done, per spec.md's own priority ordering (P1 before P2).
  - US4 (P3) depends on US2's and US3's `*Recording`/`*Saving`/`*Captura` states already existing
    to have something to abandon (T065 extends the same `ModalClosed` handler T017 stubbed).
- **Polish (Phase 7)**: Depends on all four stories being complete.

### Within Each User Story

- Domain entities/enums before repository interfaces; repository interfaces before data sources
  and usecases; usecases before bloc wiring; bloc wiring before the tab-view widget that reads it;
  DI registration before the "+"/tab-selection path that resolves the bloc from `get_it`.
- Tests are written alongside (and can be run immediately after) each implementation task, per the
  file pairing above, rather than strictly before — this project's F000/RF03 precedent write/extend
  the same test file across a story's tasks rather than one file per task.
- Story complete (domain + data + bloc + widget + tests) before moving to the next priority.

### Parallel Opportunities

- T002, T004 (Setup) in parallel with T001/T003 once each is independently actionable.
- T005, T013 (entities/connectivity) in parallel within Foundational; T015/T016/T018 (event/state/
  tab-bar skeletons) in parallel with each other and with the `entries` feature tasks.
- T008, T010, T012 (test files) can be written in parallel with each other once their respective
  implementation task lands.
- T020/T021 (US1 bloc event/state additions) in parallel with T022/T023 (US1 usecase + its test) —
  different files, both depend only on Foundational.
- T029/T030/T031 (US2 domain types) in parallel with each other; T048/T049 (US3 domain types) in
  parallel with each other.
- T036/T038 and T054/T056 (test files) in parallel with their respective sibling implementation
  task's dependents once that task lands.

---

## Parallel Example: Foundational Phase

```bash
# Launch independent entity/interface files together:
Task: "Create Entry entity + enums in lib/features/entries/domain/entities/entry.dart"
Task: "Create ConnectivityChecker in lib/core/network/connectivity_checker.dart"
Task: "Create CaptureTab enum + InsertionModalEvent base in lib/features/capture/presentation/bloc/insertion_modal_event.dart"
Task: "Create InsertionModalState base in lib/features/capture/presentation/bloc/insertion_modal_state.dart"
```

## Parallel Example: User Story 2 domain layer

```bash
Task: "Create RecognitionFailure sealed type in lib/features/capture/domain/entities/recognition_failure.dart"
Task: "Create AudioCaptureRepository interface in lib/features/capture/domain/repositories/audio_capture_repository.dart"
Task: "Create AudioTranscriptionRepository interface in lib/features/capture/domain/repositories/audio_transcription_repository.dart"
```

---

## Implementation Strategy

### MVP First (User Story 1 Only)

1. Complete Phase 1: Setup.
2. Complete Phase 2: Foundational (CRITICAL — blocks all stories).
3. Complete Phase 3: User Story 1.
4. **STOP and VALIDATE**: tap "+", type text, tap "Salvar" — a new "manual" entry exists and the
   modal closes back to Home/Chat with no other visible change.

### Incremental Delivery

1. Setup + Foundational → the `entries` feature and modal shell exist (Texto-only skeleton).
2. Add US1 → text capture works end to end; the "+" button exists for the first time.
3. Add US2 → audio capture converges on the same entry format as text (the central acceptance
   criterion, SC-001).
4. Add US3 → photo capture converges on the same entry format too; all three modalities proven
   structurally identical.
5. Add US4 → the safety property that no modality ever leaves a partial/empty entry behind.
6. Polish → RNF06/07 gates + quickstart's full manual pass.

---

## Notes

- `insertion_modal_bloc.dart`, `insertion_modal_event.dart`, `insertion_modal_state.dart`, and
  `insertion_modal_page.dart` are each touched by multiple story phases (T017/T025/T041/T059/T065
  for the bloc; T015/T020/T040/T058 for events; T016/T021/T039/T057 for states; T019/T027/T045/T062
  for the page) — this is the deliberate single-screen/single-bloc shape contracts/
  insertion-modal-bloc.md chose (mirroring RF03's `VaultBloc`), not a same-file conflict to avoid.
- `AudioTranscriptionRepository.transcribe()` deliberately returns `Either<RecognitionFailure, T>`,
  **not** `Either<Failure, T>` — it has no network call and no corresponding backend code
  (research.md R7). `PhotoRecognitionRepository.recognize()`, by contrast, is a real network call
  and reuses the existing `Failure` hierarchy unchanged.
- No task in this list touches `docs/input/`, `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`, `.env`, RF02's
  (not-yet-built) dedicated recognition-state screens, or any of RF04–RF10's behavior — all
  explicitly out of scope (FR-012, FR-013).
- `OcrResult.confidence` is carried through the full pipeline (T049, T055) but never branched on
  anywhere, including in the UI (T061) — confidence-based quality gating is explicitly RF02's
  concern (Clarification 3).

### IV. Design Token Discipline & Visual Fidelity

### V. Clean Architecture Folder Convention

```

```

layer make the domain independently testable and keep business rules

## Quality Standards (RNF01–RNF09)

These targets from `docs/input/requirements.md` are binding quality gates:

## Governance

This constitution supersedes any conflicting practice, template, or
instruction used in this repository. Every plan, spec, task list, and
review MUST verify compliance with these principles before work is
considered done; any deviation MUST be justified in writing in the relevant
artifact (plan or PR description) or the work MUST be rejected.

describing the change and rationale, and are adopted once the project owner

32	enum EntrySource { manual, audio, photo }         // `chat` added by RF10, not here (research.md R8)

41	three save usecases ever calls `CreateEntryUseCase` (Texto: the "Salvar" action is itself disabled
42	on an empty field, FR-003; Audio/Photo: an empty/whitespace recognized result is treated as a

48	abstract class EntriesRepository {
49	  Future<Either<Failure, Entry>> create({required String content, required EntrySource source});

75	The one and only sanctioned way any other feature creates an entry (research.md R8) — `capture`'s
76	three save usecases below depend on this, never on `EntriesRepository` directly.

79	
80	Spec.md's Key Entities names this as "ephemeral, device-only state that exists only while the
81	Insertion Modal is open" — in this codebase's existing convention (mirrors RF03's "Presentation-
82	only state" section: `VaultMode`, the in-progress first PIN entry), this is `InsertionModalBloc`'s
83	own state plus two bloc-private fields, not a type any other layer sees:
84	
85	| Held where | What | Lifetime |
86	|---|---|---|
87	| `InsertionModalState` (public, see contracts/insertion-modal-bloc.md) | active tab + that tab's own idle/recording/saving/failure sub-state + the Texto draft text | One `InsertionModalBloc` instance per modal open; discarded (never persisted) when the modal closes, satisfying FR-002's "reset every tab... each time the modal is freshly opened" by construction — a fresh bloc is created on every `showModalBottomSheet` call. |
88	| `_pendingAudioPath` (bloc-private `String?`) | The WAV file path `AudioCaptureRepository` wrote to, kept only so a failed transcribe-or-save can retry (FR-009) without re-recording. Cleared on successful save, on modal close, or on switching away from the Áudio tab (Edge Cases: switching tabs mid-recording discards it). | Same as above. |
89	| `_pendingImagePath` (bloc-private `String?`) | The JPEG file path `PhotoCaptureRepository` returned, kept for the same FR-009 retry-without-recapture reason. | Same as above. |
90

92	recognition's resulting text ever becomes part of an `Entry` via `CreateEntryUseCase`.
93	
94	## State transitions (per modality, per research.md R6: "confirming Save" is a different trigger each time)
95	
96	```
97	Modal opens (showModalBottomSheet, fresh InsertionModalBloc)
98	  -> InsertionModalTexto(text: '')                              # FR-002 default tab
99	
100	[Texto tab]
101	  TextDraftChanged(text) -> InsertionModalTexto(text)            # Salvar enabled iff text.trim().isNotEmpty (FR-003)
102	  SaveTextSubmitted (text non-empty, not already in flight)
103	    -> InsertionModalTextoSaving(text)
104	        ConnectivityChecker.hasConnection() == false -> InsertionModalTextoFailure(text, offlineMessage)   (FR-010)
105	        CreateEntryUseCase(text, manual)
106	            Right(entry)  -> entry appended to EntriesRepository.cachedEntries -> modal closes (FR-011)
107	            Left(failure) -> InsertionModalTextoFailure(text, failure.message)                              (FR-009)
108	
109	[Áudio tab — recording starts the instant the tab becomes active, FR-004]
110	  TabSelected(audio)
111	    -> AudioCaptureRepository.hasPermission() == false -> InsertionModalAudioPermissionDenied
112	    -> else: AudioCaptureRepository.start() -> InsertionModalAudioRecording(elapsed: 0:00)      # waveform widget subscribes directly to the amplitude stream (research.md R6/contracts)
113	  (timer ticks update `elapsed` only — no network, no recognition yet)
114	  AudioStopRequested
115	    -> path = AudioCaptureRepository.stop(); _pendingAudioPath = path
116	    -> InsertionModalAudioSaving()                                                               # plain generic loading indicator (FR-007)
117	        ConnectivityChecker.hasConnection() == false -> InsertionModalAudioFailure(offlineMessage)   (FR-010 — checked before transcribing at all, research.md R5)
118	        AudioTranscriptionRepository.transcribe(path, lang: 'pt')
119	            Left(RecognitionFailure.transcriptionError) -> InsertionModalAudioFailure(genericMessage)         (FR-009)
120	            Right(text) where text.trim().isEmpty        -> InsertionModalAudioFailure(noSpeechMessage)       (Edge Cases: silence)
121	            Right(text) -> CreateEntryUseCase(text, audio)
122	                Right(entry) -> cached; _pendingAudioPath cleared; modal closes
123	                Left(failure) -> InsertionModalAudioFailure(failure.message)     # audio file still held — RetryRequested re-enters AudioStopRequested's saving branch without a fresh recording
124	  RetryRequested (from InsertionModalAudioFailure, _pendingAudioPath != null)
125	    -> re-run the InsertionModalAudioSaving branch above against the same _pendingAudioPath
126	  TabSelected(<anything else>) while InsertionModalAudioRecording
127	    -> AudioCaptureRepository.discard(); _pendingAudioPath = null; emit the target tab's idle state   (Edge Cases)
128	
129	[Foto tab]
130	  TabSelected(photo) -> InsertionModalFotoCaptura()                                               # two buttons, no image yet (FR-005)
131	  PhotoSourceSelected(camera | gallery)
132	    -> PhotoCaptureRepository.pickImage(source)
133	        null (user cancelled the OS picker) -> stays InsertionModalFotoCaptura()                   (Edge Cases/User Story 4)
134	        path -> _pendingImagePath = path; InsertionModalFotoSaving()                                # plain generic loading indicator (FR-007)
135	            ConnectivityChecker.hasConnection() == false -> InsertionModalFotoFailure(offlineMessage)   (FR-010)
136	            PhotoRecognitionRepository.recognize(path)
137	                Left(OcrNoTextFailure) or Right(text) where text.trim().isEmpty -> InsertionModalFotoFailure(noTextMessage)   (Edge Cases: illegible/blank image)
138	                Left(otherFailure) -> InsertionModalFotoFailure(failure.message)
139	                Right(text) [confidence ignored — Clarification 3] -> CreateEntryUseCase(text, photo)
140	                    Right(entry) -> cached; _pendingImagePath cleared; modal closes
141	                    Left(failure) -> InsertionModalFotoFailure(failure.message)   # image still held — RetryRequested re-enters this branch
142	  RetryRequested (from InsertionModalFotoFailure, _pendingImagePath != null)
143	    -> re-run the recognize+create branch above against the same _pendingImagePath
144	
145	[Any tab, any sub-state] ModalClosed (close button, scrim tap, system back)

147	```

150	
151	| Repository | Return type | Why |
152	|---|---|---|
153	| `EntriesRepository.create()` | `Either<Failure, Entry>` | Real network call; reuses F000's closed 13-code hierarchy unchanged. |
154	| `PhotoRecognitionRepository.recognize()` | `Either<Failure, OcrResult>` | Real network call to `media-ocr`; `OcrNoTextFailure`/`OCR_NO_TEXT` already exists in `failure.dart` from F000 and covers the illegible/blank-image Edge Case directly. |

158	running 15-scenario total (`entries-create` and `media-ocr` are two of the spec's five write
159	endpoints):
160	
161	| Endpoint | Scenario | Expected `Failure` |
162	|---|---|---|
163	| `entries-create` | Timeout / No connection / Malformed response | `NetworkTimeoutFailure` / `NetworkOfflineFailure` / `ValidationFailure` |
164	| `media-ocr` | Timeout / No connection / Malformed response | `NetworkTimeoutFailure` / `NetworkOfflineFailure` / `ValidationFailure` |
165	
166	## Design Tokens (`lib/core/design_tokens.dart`)
167	
168	No additions — see research.md R10. Every value the three tabs need (primary/outline/text
169	buttons, text field states, `colorError`, `sizeLoadingIndicator`/`strokeWidthLoadingIndicator`,
170	spacing, radii, type scale) already exists from F000/RF03.

# Contract: Photo capture & recognition (`lib/features/capture/domain/`)

Mirrors audio-capture-repository.md's split, but `PhotoRecognitionRepository` is a real network
call and so reuses the existing `Failure` hierarchy unchanged (research.md R7) rather than needing
a new local-only failure type.

```dart
// lib/features/capture/domain/repositories/photo_capture_repository.dart
enum PhotoSource { camera, gallery }

abstract class PhotoCaptureRepository {
  Future<String?> pickImage(PhotoSource source);   // null == user cancelled the OS picker (Edge Cases/User Story 4)
}

// lib/features/capture/domain/repositories/photo_recognition_repository.dart
class OcrResult {
  final String text;
  final String confidence;   // "high" | "low" — carried through, never branched on (Clarification 3)
}

abstract class PhotoRecognitionRepository {
  Future<Either<Failure, OcrResult>> recognize(String imageFilePath);
}
```

- **`ImagePickerDataSource`** (`lib/features/capture/data/image_picker_data_source.dart`) is the
  only class importing `image_picker`'s `ImagePicker`/`ImageSource`/`XFile` types, always calling
  `pickImage(source: ..., imageQuality: 90)` (research.md R3) so every returned file is JPEG
  regardless of the original asset format (notably HEIC from the iOS Photos library, which
  `media-ocr`'s contract does not accept at all).
- **`MediaOcrRemoteDataSource`** (`lib/features/capture/data/media_ocr_remote_data_source.dart`)
  reads the picked file's bytes, `base64Encode`s them (`dart:convert`, no new package), and calls
  `ApiClient.call('media-ocr', method: 'POST', body: {'image': base64, 'mimeType': 'image/jpeg'})`
  (research.md R4) — reusing `ApiClient`/`ErrorMapper` unmodified. `OCR_NO_TEXT` is already a
  mapped `Failure` subtype (`OcrNoTextFailure`, present in `core/network/failure.dart` since F000)
  and is exactly the Edge Case "illegible/blank image" outcome.
- **Client-side empty-text guard**: if the backend ever answers `200` with a `text` that is empty
  or whitespace-only (rather than the `OCR_NO_TEXT` error), `PhotoRecognitionRepositoryImpl` treats
  it identically to receiving `OcrNoTextFailure` — a defensive normalization, not a new failure
  type, so `SavePhotoEntryUseCase` has exactly one "no usable text" branch to handle regardless of
  which of the two ways the backend expressed it.
- **Who depends on this**: `SavePhotoEntryUseCase` (both repositories), `InsertionModalBloc`
  (`pickImage`, to drive the Foto tab's sub-states). No `presentation/` widget calls either
  repository directly.

# Contract: Audio capture & transcription (`lib/features/capture/domain/`)

Two separate domain interfaces, deliberately not merged (research.md R1/R7): one wraps the
`record` plugin (device I/O, no network, no recognition), the other wraps on-device `whisper_ggml`
(recognition, still no network). Neither crosses into `presentation/` directly — `InsertionModalBloc`
only ever calls these through `capture/domain/usecases/save_audio_entry_usecase.dart`, except for
the live amplitude stream (below).

```dart
// lib/features/capture/domain/repositories/audio_capture_repository.dart
abstract class AudioCaptureRepository {
  Future<bool> hasPermission();           // `record`'s own OS mic-permission request (research.md R1)
  Future<void> start();                   // begins recording to a fresh 16 kHz mono WAV temp file
  Stream<double> get amplitudeStream;      // forwarded from `record`'s onAmplitudeChanged — read directly
                                           // by the waveform widget via get_it, NOT routed through
                                           // InsertionModalBloc's event stream (too high-frequency to
                                           // belong in bloc event history)
  Future<String> stop();                   // stops; returns the finished WAV file's path
  void discard();                          // stops (if active) and deletes the temp file, no path returned
}

// lib/features/capture/domain/repositories/audio_transcription_repository.dart
sealed class RecognitionFailure {}
class EmptyRecognitionResult extends RecognitionFailure {}     // transcript was empty/whitespace-only
class TranscriptionError extends RecognitionFailure {}         // whisper_ggml threw / model failed to load

abstract class AudioTranscriptionRepository {
  Future<Either<RecognitionFailure, String>> transcribe(String audioFilePath);
}
```

- **`AudioRecorderDataSource`** (`lib/features/capture/data/audio_recorder_data_source.dart`) is
  the only class importing `record`'s `AudioRecorder`/`RecordConfig`/`AudioEncoder` types —
  `AudioCaptureRepositoryImpl` maps everything to plain `bool`/`String`/`Stream<double>` before it
  reaches `domain/` (RNF06, mirrors RF03's `LocalAuthBiometricDataSource` boundary).
- **`WhisperTranscriptionDataSource`** (`lib/features/capture/data/whisper_transcription_data_source.dart`)
  is the only class importing `whisper_ggml`'s `WhisperController`/`WhisperModel` types. It owns the
  one-time "copy the bundled model asset to a writable path" step (research.md R2) the first time
  `transcribe()` is called; subsequent calls reuse the already-copied file.
- **`transcribe()`'s empty-result rule**: a transcript that is empty or whitespace-only after
  `.trim()` is reported as `Left(EmptyRecognitionResult())`, not `Right('')` — this is what makes
  the silence Edge Case ("Save fails with a clear message rather than creating an empty or
  near-empty entry") true without `SaveAudioEntryUseCase` needing its own blank-check duplicated
  across audio and photo (photo's equivalent check lives in `PhotoRecognitionRepository`/the
  backend's own `OCR_NO_TEXT` code instead — see photo-capture-repository.md).
- **Why `discard()` has no return value**: callers that need `stop()`'s path (to transcribe it)
  always call `stop()`; callers that abandon a capture (modal closed, tab switched away mid-
  recording — Edge Cases) always call `discard()` and never look at a path, since FR-008 requires
  that nothing from an abandoned capture ever reaches `CreateEntryUseCase`.
- **Who depends on this**: `SaveAudioEntryUseCase` (both repositories), `InsertionModalBloc`
  (`start`/`stop`/`discard`/`hasPermission`, to drive its own sub-states), the waveform widget
  (`amplitudeStream` only, read via `get_it` directly — the one sanctioned exception to "always
  through the bloc" for this unit, justified above).

1	# Contract: Save orchestration (`lib/features/capture/domain/usecases/`) + `ConnectivityChecker`
2	
3	The three usecases that tie `entries/` (contracts/entries-repository.md) together with `capture/`'s
4	own audio/photo repositories (contracts/audio-capture-repository.md,
5	contracts/photo-capture-repository.md) and the new offline gate (research.md R5). Each is the one
6	thing `InsertionModalBloc` calls per modality's Save trigger (research.md R6) — the bloc itself
7	never calls `CreateEntryUseCase`, `AudioTranscriptionRepository`, or `PhotoRecognitionRepository`
8	directly.
9	
10	```dart
11	// lib/core/network/connectivity_checker.dart (core, not capture-specific — research.md R5)
12	class ConnectivityChecker {
13	  Future<bool> hasConnection() async =>
14	      (await Connectivity().checkConnectivity()) != ConnectivityResult.none;
15	}
16	
17	// lib/features/capture/domain/usecases/save_text_entry_usecase.dart
18	class SaveTextEntryUseCase {
19	  Future<Either<Failure, Entry>> call(String text) async {
20	    if (!await _connectivity.hasConnection()) {
21	      return Left(NetworkOfflineFailure(message: _offlineMessage, requestId: ''));
22	    }
23	    return _createEntry(text, EntrySource.manual);
24	  }
25	}
26	
27	// lib/features/capture/domain/usecases/save_audio_entry_usecase.dart
28	class SaveAudioEntryUseCase {
29	  Future<Either<SaveAudioFailure, Entry>> call(String audioFilePath) async {
30	    if (!await _connectivity.hasConnection()) {
31	      return Left(SaveAudioFailure.offline);                      // checked BEFORE transcribing — research.md R5
32	    }
33	    final transcribed = await _transcriptionRepository.transcribe(audioFilePath);
34	    return transcribed.match(
35	      (recognitionFailure) => Left(SaveAudioFailure.recognition),
36	      (text) async => (await _createEntry(text, EntrySource.audio))
37	          .match(
38	            (failure) => Left(SaveAudioFailure.entryCreation(failure)),
39	            (entry) => Right(entry),
40	          ),
41	    );
42	  }
43	}
44	
45	// lib/features/capture/domain/usecases/save_photo_entry_usecase.dart — same shape as audio,
46	// substituting PhotoRecognitionRepository.recognize(imageFilePath) for the transcription call,
47	// and its own SavePhotoFailure (offline | recognition | entryCreation(Failure)).
48	```
49	
50	- **Why `SaveAudioEntryUseCase`/`SavePhotoEntryUseCase` don't just return `Either<Failure, Entry>`
51	  like the text path**: their failure side needs to distinguish "offline" / "recognition failed
52	  (no corresponding `Failure`, research.md R7)" / "entry creation itself failed (a real
53	  `Failure`)" so `InsertionModalBloc` can show the right generic message for each — but all three
54	  render through the *same* plain failure-and-retry UI (research.md R11), so this distinction is
55	  for message selection only, never for a styling branch.

57	  at the start of each usecase, not re-checked between transcription/recognition and entry
58	  creation — a device that goes offline in the few seconds between those two steps surfaces as a
59	  normal `NetworkOfflineFailure` from the `entries-create` call itself (the existing reactive path),

63	  `PhotoSourceSelected` while already in a `*Saving` state, so each usecase here is only ever
64	  invoked once per confirmed capture regardless of UI mashing.

66	  per-dependency-graph pattern as every other usecase in this codebase), constructed from
67	  `CreateEntryUseCase`, the relevant `capture` repositories, and the shared `ConnectivityChecker`.

```

**File**: `specs/003-multimodal-capture/spec.md`, line 91 (Edge Cases)

```diff

On return (after a mere backgrounding, the modal resumes normally; after a kill, the modal reopens to its default empty state), and if the content was lost to a process kill, the user must recapture rather than retry.
```
